camel_example: aliyun alb UpdateServerGroupServersAttribute --region cn-hangzhou --Servers.1.ServerType Ecs --Servers.1.Description test --Servers.1.ServerId 'i-bp1f9kdprbgy9uiu0000' --Servers.1.Port 80 --ServerGroupId 'sgp-atstuj3rtop0000' --Servers.1.Weight 100 --Servers.1.ServerIp '192.168.1.1' --method POST --force
description_en: Updates the configurations of backend servers in a server group, such as weights and descriptions
description_zh: 更新服务器组中后端服务器的权重和描述等配置
kebab_example: aliyun alb update-server-group-servers-attribute --server-group-id sgp-atstuj3rtop0000 --servers ServerType=Ecs Description=test ServerId=i-bp1f9kdprbgy9uiu0000 Port=80 ServerIp=192.168.1.1 Weight=100 --region cn-hangzhou
name: UpdateServerGroupServersAttribute

fields.help_en: The description of the backend server. The description must be 2 to 256 characters in length and cannot start with http:// or https://
fields.help_zh: 后端服务器描述。长度为 2~256 个英文或中文字符，不能以http://和https://开头
fields.name: description

fields.help_en:
The port used by the backend server. Valid values: 1 to 65535.
This parameter does not take effect when ServerType is set to Fc
fields.help_zh:
后端服务器使用的端口。取值范围：1~65535。
当ServerType取值为Fc时，无需配置该参数
fields.name: port

fields.help_en:
The backend server ID.

If ServerType is set to Ecs, Eni, or Eci, this parameter specifies the resource ID of the ECS instance, ENI, or ECI.
If ServerType is set to Ip, this parameter specifies the IP address.
If ServerType is set to Fc, this parameter specifies the ARN of the function
fields.help_zh:
后端服务器ID。

当ServerType取值为Ecs、Eni、Eci时，该参数为Ecs、Eni、Eci的资源ID。
当ServerType取值为Ip时，该参数为IP地址。
当ServerType取值为Fc时，该参数为函数计算的ARN标识
fields.name: server_id

fields.help_en:
The server type of the backend server. Valid values:
Ecs: ECS instance.
Eni: network interface controller (NIC).
Eci: elastic container instance.
Ip: IP address.
Fc: Function Compute
fields.help_zh:
后端服务器类型。取值：
Ecs：ECS实例。
Eni：ENI弹性网卡实例。
Eci：ECI弹性容器。
Ip：IP地址。
Fc：函数计算
fields.name: server_type

fields.help_en:
The weight of the backend server. Valid values: 0 to 100. Default value: 100. If the weight is set to 0, no requests are forwarded to the backend server. You can specify up to 40 servers in a single request.

This parameter does not take effect when ServerType is set to Fc
fields.help_zh:
后端服务器的权重。取值范围：0~100。默认值为100。如果设置权重为0，则不会将请求转发给该后端服务器。单次调用最多支持传入40个服务器。

当ServerType取值为Fc时，无需配置该参数
fields.name: weight

parameters.help_en: The backend server group list. You can specify up to 40 servers in a single invoke
parameters.help_zh: 后端服务器组列表，单次调用最多支持传入40个服务器
parameters.name: servers

parameters.help_en:
The client token that is used to ensure the idempotence of the request.

You can use the client to generate the token, but you must make sure that the token is unique among different requests. The token can contain only ASCII characters.

If you do not specify this parameter, the system automatically uses the RequestId of the API request as the ClientToken. The RequestId may be different for each API request
parameters.help_zh:
客户端Token，用于保证请求的幂等性。

从您的客户端生成一个参数值，确保不同请求间该参数值唯一。ClientToken只支持ASCII字符。

若您未指定，则系统自动使用API请求的RequestId作为ClientToken标识。每次API请求的RequestId不一样
parameters.name: client_token

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether to perform a dry run. Valid values:
true: performs a dry run. The system checks the request for potential issues, including missing parameter values, incorrect request format, and service limits. If the request fails the dry run, an error code is returned. If the request passes the dry run, the `DryRunOperation` error code is returned.
false (default): sends a Normal request, passes the dry run, and returns an HTTP 2xx status code. The operation to update the weight and description of the backend server in the server group is directly performed
parameters.help_zh:
是否只预检此次请求，取值：
true：发送检查请求，不会更新服务器组中后端服务器的权重和描述等配置信息。检查项包括是否填写了必需参数、请求格式、业务限制。如果检查不通过，则返回对应错误。如果检查通过，则返回错误码`DryRunOperation`。
false（默认值）：发送正常请求，通过检查后返回HTTP 2xx状态码并直接进行操作
parameters.name: dry_run
